description: Mock ONLY at architectural boundaries: external APIs, network, uncontrollable services. Don't mock internal business logic, classes under test, or file operations (use temp files). Example: patch('requests.get') (OK); patch('agent.validate') (wrong)

do.description: Mock only external dependencies you can't control. Example: with patch('requests.get') as mock: (external API - OK to mock)

guidance.description: Mock external services (monitoring, logging to external)
Use real temp files instead of mocking file I/O
example: agent = Agent.from_config_file(config_file)  # Real file, no mock

dont.description: Don't mock internal logic, class under test, or file I/O. Example: with patch('agent.validate_config') (wrong - test the logic!)

guidance.description: Don't mock the class you're testing
example: agent = Mock(spec=Agent)  # WRONG - defeats purpose of test
with patch('agent.validate_config'):  # WRONG - test the validation!

guidance.description: Don't mock file operations when temp files work
example: with patch('pathlib.Path.read_text'):  # WRONG - use real temp file

guidance.description: Don't mock collaborators that are simple value objects
example: config = Mock()  # WRONG if Config is just a dict/dataclass - use real one
